title: What came between Liao dynasty and Mongol Empire?
question: What came between Liao dynasty and Mongol Empire?
claim: 2 documented links lead from Liao dynasty (916) to Mongol Empire (1206): 0 of cause and effect, 2 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.

records.description: Khitan imperial dynasty in East Asia (916-1125), controlling northern and northeastern China, Mongolia, Russian Far East and North Korea
